# forge-usd-priced-membership-nft

> Composed membership NFT: ERC-721 with max supply, ERC-2981 royalties, pause switch, MINTER/PAUSER roles and a paid mint priced in USD through a Chainlink ETH/USD feed with staleness checks and refunds (UsdPricedMembership). Good base for token-gated apps.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/forge-usd-priced-membership-nft/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/forge-usd-priced-membership-nft/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/forge-usd-priced-membership-nft/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)
